How-to guides are practical, goal-oriented recipes.  Unlike tutorials
(which teach concepts in a fixed order), each how-to guide solves a
specific problem and can be read independently.

**Prerequisites:** Familiarity with the core concepts from the
[Tutorials](tutorials.qmd) is recommended but not strictly required.

## How-To Notebooks

::: {#howto-listing}
:::


## Topics at a Glance

The guides are grouped into the same four topics used throughout the
documentation:

### Timelines, Events & Maps

- [How to Work with DataFields and Layered EventData](howto/how01_datafields_and_eventdata.ipynb) ---
  Data-access axis: raw DataFields, SemanticField composition,
  Layer 0/1/2, PitchField blueprints, Parquet round-trip.
- [How to Work with Pitch and Harmony Types](howto/how01_pitch_and_harmony_types.ipynb) ---
  Type-design axis: Protocol/Scalar/Field for pitch and harmony,
  conversion, protocol dispatch, Parquet round-trip.
- [How to Do Coordinate Math](howto/how01_coordinate_math.ipynb) ---
  Domains, TimeUnits, NumberType, and Coordinate arithmetic.
- [How to Use Advanced Conversion Maps](howto/how01_advanced_cmaps.ipynb) ---
  ChainMap, PiecewiseMap, TableMap, and vectorised operations.
- [How to Query Timestamps](howto/how01_advanced_timestamps.ipynb) ---
  TimeStamp, TimeIntervalStamp, boundary tables, and PyArrow.
- [How to Construct Timelines Manually](howto/how01_manual_timeline_construction.ipynb) ---
  Events via dict, parent/child hierarchies, and serialisation.
- [How to Load Data](howto/how01_loading_data.ipynb) ---
  Format-agnostic data ingestion with Loaders and EventStores.
- [How to Load Tabular Data](howto/how01_tabular_loaders.ipynb) ---
  CoordinateField, ComputedField, and custom loader configuration.
- [How to Work with Graphical Timelines](howto/how01_graphical_timelines.ipynb) ---
  TimeAxisPath, image-based timelines, and pixel-to-time conversion.
- [How to Transfer Annotations Between Graphical Analyses](howto/how01_thoresen_annotation_transfer.ipynb) ---
  SegmentLine, ConstantMap, MatchClaim.from_projection, y-coordinate transfer.
- [How to Build Beat Grids](howto/how01_beat_grids.ipynb) ---
  BeatGrid, FloorMap, RotationMap, and measure/beat queries.

### TimelineGroups

- [How to Align a Piano Roll (SUPRA)](howto/how02_supra_piano_roll.ipynb) ---
  End-to-end alignment: IIIF images, ATON, MIDI, Audio, and Score.

### AlignmentBundles

- [How to Create a Note Alignment](howto/how03_create_note_alignment.ipynb) ---
  MatchClaims, AlignmentBundle, MatchLines, and cross-group MatchStamps.
- [How to Align Multimodal Data (Beethoven)](howto/how03_beethoven_multimodal.ipynb) ---
  AlignmentBundle, FlowMap, OMR, 16+ timelines across 3 domains.
- [How to Load the Vienna 4x22 Corpus](howto/how03_loading_vienna_corpus.ipynb) ---
  MatchfileLoader, 22 performances, AlignmentBundle.
- [How to Load an Audio-to-Score Alignment Corpus and Compare Performances](howto/how05_performance_precision.ipynb) ---
  PerformancePrecisionLoader, MetricMap from a Verovio timemap,
  granularity-tagged MatchClaims, cross-performer tempo comparison.
- [How to Load a parangonada Note Alignment Across Several Performances](howto/how06_parangonada.ipynb) ---
  ParangonadaLoader, one multimodal AlignmentBundle across five performances,
  divs/quarters and samples/seconds C-Maps, synchronous and NOMATCH MatchClaims.

### In-depth Topics

- [How to Encode Song Genesis (Hendrix)](howto/how04_hendrix_song_genesis.ipynb) ---
  MatchClaim (synchronous vs conceptual), NOMATCH sentinels, TiliaJsonLoader.
- [How to Load CSV/TSV with column_specs and field_specs](howto/how04_loading_csv.ipynb) ---
  DataField blueprints, the Step-1 resolution chain, CompositeFieldParser,
  and a from-scratch `.solo` loader.
